name: 손 동작 일관성
description: Detects malformed hand artifacts common in AI-generated videos.
useCase: Identifying AI videos through hand region analysis
mechanism: Analyzes lower frame regions for complex edge patterns combined with smooth textures, which indicate AI-generated hands with incorrect finger counts or geometry.
source: Yang et al. (2023) - Diffusion-Based Zero-Shot Deepfake Detection
algorithm: Hand Region Edge Complexity + Smooth Ratio Analysis
parameters: Block size: adaptive, Analysis region: face/body, Metrics: gradient energy, variance ratio
strengths:
- Effective for detecting AI-generated video artifacts
- Works across different video resolutions
- Complements other forensic analysis methods
- Low computational overhead per frame
limitations:
- Requires video input (not applicable to images)
- May produce false positives on heavily processed videos
- Performance varies with video quality
- Single-frame analysis limits temporal assessment

references.title: Yang et al. (2023) - Diffusion-Based Zero-Shot Deepfake Detection
Ciftci, U. et al. (2020). FakeCatcher: Detection of Synthetic Portrait Videos using Biological Signals. IEEE TPAMI.
Zhao, H. et al. (2021). Multi-Attentional Deepfake Detection. CVPR.
